company.shortDescription: Piazza is a social learning platform connecting students, instructors, and employers.
company.description: Piazza is a learning platform designed to connect students, TAs, and professors in order for every student to get help whenever they need it. Users can start a class at Piazza.com and collaborate in real time with classmates and instructors to find the answers they need.

productsAndServices.description: An online platform for class Q&A that enables students, TAs, and instructors to post, answer, and collaborate on questions in a shared space.
productsAndServices.name: Piazza Q&A

productsAndServices.description: A careers-oriented platform that connects students who opt in with employers for job opportunities and career guidance.
productsAndServices.name: Piazza Network

productsAndServices.description: A recruiting service that helps employers connect with student talent from the Piazza user base, focusing on diversity and inclusion in hiring.
productsAndServices.name: Piazza Talent

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $8,000,000, or 51.61% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,277,342 to $37,976,460, a 5.22x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 39 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 21 (-3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
